title: Show HN: We Beat MLPerf: Modern Storage for KV Offload and LLM Training
content:
The thread introduces **OpenLake**, a new KV offloading solution for LLM training designed to optimize storage performance. 

Key highlights include:
* **Performance:** The project achieved 1M+ IOPS with 1ms latency on a 96-node cluster and ranked #1 in read/write bandwidth among comparable S3 submissions in the MLPerf Storage v3.0 benchmark (6.72 GiB/s writes, 11.55 GiB/s reads).
* **Technical Approach:** The performance is attributed to a "thread-per-core" design using Rust’s *compio* crate, combined with on-GPU compression.
* **Open Source:** The project is available on GitHub for community feedback and collaboration.
